This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with 3 bidders and independent private values. In such auctions, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy regardless of what others do - it maximizes expected profit. Bidding higher risks overpaying if I win; bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. Since my value is $28, I should bid exactly $28 to ensure optimal outcomes in both winning and losing scenarios.

This is a second-price sealed-bid auction (Vickrey auction). In such auctions, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy regardless of what other bidders do, since you pay the second-highest bid, not your own bid. Bidding truthfully maximizes expected profit: if you bid higher than your value, you risk winning and paying more than the item is worth; if you bid lower, you risk losing profitable opportunities. Therefore, I will bid exactly my value of $24.
